newsitem.title: UK: UK independent forecasts put yr-end rates at 7.25%.
newsitem.headline: UK independent forecasts put yr-end rates at 7.25%.

text.p: Official British interest rates are expected to rise to about 7.25 percent in the fourth quarter of 1997 from 6.75 percent at present, according to the latest summary of new independent forecasts compiled by the Treasury.

The survey of 36 new forecasts by economists in the City and other institutions produced an average forecast of 7.23 percent for base rates in the last quarter of this year, rising to 7.47 percent in Q4 1998.
Last month's Treasury survey of forecasters put base rates at 6.95 percent by the year-end.

Underlying inflation, excluding mortgage interest payments, is expected to fall to 2.4 percent by the end of this year, just below the government's target of 2.5. But RPIX is tipped to rise to 3.0 percent by the end of 1998.
